title: EuroHPC User Days 2026
summary: Engaged with the European supercomputing user community on best practices for projects using EuroHPC HPC, quantum computing and AI resources. Presented a live demo of the Deucalion supercomputer's Open OnDemand environment, showcasing interactive applications such as VAPOR, VMD, vLLM and llama.cpp, and workloads including AlphaFold3, ECMWF's AIFS weather forecasting model and AMALIA, the Portuguese large language model.

title: CBMS 2026 - 39th IEEE International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems
summary: Oral presentation of the paper *OHANA: Optimizing Heterogeneous Multi-Artifact Correction in Neuroimaging Analysis*.

title: Jornadas FCCN 2026
summary: Live demonstration of the Deucalion and MareNostrum 5 European supercomputers in the session *Demonstração Deucalion & MareNostrum 5: Supercomputação Europeia na vanguarda*.

title: Invited Lecture - Transformação Digital na Saúde com IA
summary: Showed how to optimize large-scale LLM inference on the multi-node ARM-based architecture of the Deucalion supercomputer.

title: EPICURE Hackathon on Code Optimisation for Heterogeneous HPC Environments
summary: Co-organizer and mentor. Guided participants through performance profiling, parallel computing and code portability across heterogeneous HPC architectures, with hands-on support for llama.cpp, vLLM, AlphaFold3, GROMACS and Qiskit on Deucalion.

title: Invited Lecture - Distributed LLM Inference with llama.cpp
location: University of Minho, Master's in Advanced Computing
summary: Single- and multi-node deployment and benchmarking of llama.cpp with Slurm on ARM-based infrastructure: llama-server and RPC workers, resource allocation, InfiniBand communication, and latency/throughput evaluation under different tuning configurations.

title: SC25 - Supercomputing Conference
summary: Participated in the leading international conference on high-performance computing, networking, storage and analysis.

title: Encontro de Computação Avançada 2025
summary: Represented Deucalion at the 5th Advanced Computing Meeting, a national event on HPC and advanced computing.

title: European Researchers' Night 2025
summary: Represented the Deucalion supercomputer, presenting LLM inference system models implemented on Deucalion at a science outreach event on *Science for Global Challenges*.

title: InovIA 2025 - Invited Talk
summary: *Deucalion: HPC for Startups and SMEs* at the launch of InovIA, an FCCN/FCT program giving startups and SMEs access to HPC and AI resources.

title: Jornadas FCCN 2025
summary: Annual FCCN/FCT event on advanced digital services for higher education and research: connectivity, computing, collaboration, knowledge and security.

title: Invited Lecture - Distributed ML Training, Experiment Tracking and Management
location: University of Minho, Master's in Advanced Computing
summary: Training a PyTorch model with TensorBoard and MLflow integration, monitoring loss, accuracy, CPU and memory, and running the full workflow on Deucalion through Open OnDemand.

title: Flower AI Summit 2025
summary: Talks and workshops on federated learning, distributed AI systems and privacy-preserving ML.

title: EuroHPC Summit 2025
summary: Presented a live demo of LLM inference (Llama 3 and DeepSeek) on the Deucalion supercomputer, showcasing its performance and AI readiness.

title: EPICURE HPC in ARM Architecture Hackathon 2025
summary: Contributed to performance tuning and code portability of HPC applications on ARM, and presented a live demo of PyTorch models and LLMs running on Deucalion.

title: Encontro Nacional de Computação Avançada 2024
summary: Presented the capabilities of the Deucalion supercomputer for job submission, running DL models, and MLOps integration (TensorBoard and MLflow) for workflow monitoring.

title: ACM Europe Summer School on HPC Computer Architectures for AI and Dedicated Applications
summary: Lectures and workshops on HPC & AI convergence, RISC-V, LLMs, ML in materials research and quantum computing, with a keynote by Turing Award laureate Leslie Lamport.
